messages:
alex: Quick Q — I'm returning from parental leave on Nov 15 and switching to 0.6 FTE. Current PTO balance in Workday shows 160 hrs; our documented carryover cap is 80 hrs. Can we make an exception because the leave prevented me from using PTO? Also, do we pro-rate carryover when someone's FTE changes?

maria (People Ops): Congrats! Short answer: we can grant a leave-related carryover exception in specific cases. Need the exact leave dates and manager approval. We typically allow a one-time exception tied to a leave window and add a temporary payroll override.

alex: Do I need manager sign-off on the form or is People Ops approval enough?

sam (Eng Manager): I approve. Happy to sign whatever you need, @alex. :tada:

maria (People Ops): Manager sign-off is required. Please complete the Leave Carryover Request form (link: https://intranet.redwood/poforms/leave-carryover). Include: leave start/end, return FTE, current PTO balance, and a manager approval screenshot. We then set an "leave-carryover" override that keeps the extra hours in a special bucket with usage rules.

alex: Are there limits on how long that override bucket lasts? Any blackout weeks that would affect scheduling?

hr-bot: System: Company observed holidays: 12/25, 12/26. Official shutdown days (if any) are posted by Finance in #announcements. 12/24 is not an automatic paid holiday.

jess (People Ops): The override carryover must be used within 18 months of your return date. It doesn't expire during approved company blackout windows, but you still need manager approval for specific PTO dates. For part-time transitions, accrual rates change on the return date; we compute pro-rated carryover based on the new FTE.

alex: Could you show the pro-rate calc so I can estimate my balance?

maria (People Ops): Sure — rough calc we use (examples only):
```
new_accrual_rate = base_accrual_rate * new_FTE
pro_rated_carryover = floor(original_carryover * new_FTE / old_FTE)
final_carryover = min(pro_rated_carryover, carryover_cap)
```
Example: 160 hrs balance, old_FTE 1.0, new_FTE 0.6, cap 80 -> pro_rated_carryover = floor(160*0.6/1.0)=96 -> final_carryover = min(96,80)=80.

sam (Eng Manager): Payroll note — tag requests with `leave-carryover-exception` so Payroll applies it before the next cut. I'll add my signed approval to the submitted form.

alex: Thanks. I'll submit the form today and attach the signed approval. One last Q — can approved carryover be cashed out mid-employment instead of used as time off?

jess (People Ops): Cash-out mid-employment is not standard. It is only approved in exceptional circumstances and requires Exec + Finance sign-off. If you're moving to part-time permanently we can discuss a tailored plan but expect the default to be time-off usage.

maria (People Ops): Got it — @alex, once you submit we'll confirm within 3 business days and copy Payroll. Ping us if you need help filling the form. :eyes:
